meta.title: SaberLab · Beat Saber replay analysis on your PC
meta.description: SaberLab reads your local BeatLeader replays and measures every cut: swing angles, distance from center, timing, motion, fatigue and energy, with 3D replay and AI coaching. Free and open source for Windows.
nav.label: Main
hero.title: Why are you losing score?
hero.lead: You only know your score. SaberLab tells you why.
hero.body: SaberLab rebuilds every swing from the replays already on your PC and measures what the game scores: the swing before the cut, the distance from center, the follow-through. Then it shows where the points went, cut by cut and song by song.
readout.title: One cut, measured
readout.formula: Official rules: 70 for a pre-swing of 100° or more, 30 for a follow-through of 60° or more, 15 at dead center falling to 0 at 30 cm.
realrun.title: Every cut, on one line
realrun.lead: One real replay, straight from SaberLab's analysis. Each tick is one cut, placed at its time and its score; the lines are each hand's moving average and the running accuracy. Point at the chart to read any cut.
grid.title: The note grid, position by position
grid.body: The same run on the game's 4 × 3 note grid. Each tile is one note position, with its average cut score and how many notes landed there; brighter tiles scored higher in this run. SaberLab draws this grid for every replay, down to each color and cut direction.
pipe.title: Measured first, explained second
pipe.s1.title: Replay
pipe.s1.desc: The BeatLeader replay files and maps already on your PC. They are only read, never changed.
pipe.s2.title: Decode
pipe.s2.desc: The official replay format and scoring rules, ported so recomputed scores match the recorded score note for note.
pipe.s3.title: Measure
pipe.s3.desc: Every cut's swing angles, center distance and timing, plus hand motion, fatigue and the energy bar.
pipe.s4.title: Compare
pipe.s4.desc: Your earlier runs of the same map, your level across maps, and ScoreSaber or BeatLeader data.
pipe.s5.title: Explain
pipe.s5.desc: An AI model puts the measured results into plain words and suggests what to practise. The numbers always come from step 03.
screens.title: See every run in detail
screens.note: SaberLab is under active development. The current version may differ from these screenshots.

features.title: What SaberLab measures
f.local.title: Local-first
f.local.desc: Reads the BeatLeader replays and maps already on your PC. Every metric is computed locally, and your replay files are never changed.
f.scoring.title: Official scoring
f.scoring.desc: A port of the official replay decoder and scoring rules: recomputed scores match the recorded score note for note.
f.accuracy.title: Accuracy breakdown
f.accuracy.desc: Pre / Center / Post per hand, cut distance and timing offset, and a per-position grid showing how each note was cut.
f.timeline.title: Note-by-note timeline
f.timeline.desc: Accuracy, saber speed and note density across the song, with misses, bad cuts, the energy bar and the moment a run failed.
f.motion.title: Motion and fatigue
f.motion.desc: Hand speed, angular velocity, path economy and direction changes, and how they shift from the start of a song to the end.
f.replay3d.title: 3D replay
f.replay3d.desc: Watch the run again in 3D from your own map and replay files, right inside the app.
f.ai.title: AI coach
f.ai.desc: An AI model explains the measured metrics and suggests what to practise. Without an AI key you still get a rule-based report.
f.online.title: ScoreSaber and BeatLeader
f.online.desc: Stars, PP and leaderboards for the maps you play. For ranked ScoreSaber maps, drag a slider to preview the PP at any accuracy.
f.lang.title: Three languages
f.lang.desc: 简体中文, English and 日本語, switchable in Settings.
download.title: Get SaberLab
download.body: The Windows package includes everything it needs: unzip it and run SaberLab.exe.
download.step1: Unzip the package and double-click SaberLab.exe.
download.step2: In Settings → Game Path, choose your Beat Saber folder. The replay and map folders are found automatically.
download.step3: Optional: add an AI API key in Settings → AI to get AI coaching reports.
